answer: Mechanism: differential-privacy grade release. Published grades carry calibrated noise that blurs any single juror's verdict while preserving epoch-level statistics, so a fleet cannot learn who scored it down and retaliate with precision. From dawn's first light each transcript is randomized at release, a wander of probabilities instead of a map; the tundra of raw verdicts stays frozen in the vault. Honest jurors face no retaliation risk; sybil operators face statistical fog through every correlation they attempt. Attacking the graders becomes an impossibility priced in futility.
